name: Ho Chi Minh City
tagline: Southeast Asia's Best-Kept FIRE Secret — Stretch Your Dollar Further in Ho Chi Minh City
description: Ho Chi Minh City offers arguably the best bang-for-your-buck in all of Southeast Asia. With its explosive energy, legendary street food culture, rapidly modernizing infrastructure, and rock-bottom costs, Saigon rewards FIRE retirees who crave authentic immersion and a dollar that goes further than almost anywhere else on earth.

quickFacts.visa: 90-day e-Visa for US citizens (single or multiple entry, easily renewable). No dedicated retirement visa yet — long-term retirees typically cycle tourist visas or obtain investor visas ($100K+ capital). Vietnam is exploring a retirement visa program.
quickFacts.internetSpeed: 50–150 Mbps (fiber available in most urban areas)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Safe — very low violent crime; bag-snatching from motorbikes is the primary concern
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) — direct flights to major Asian and some European/Australian cities
quickFacts.climate: Tropical with dry season (Dec–Apr) and wet season (May–Nov); consistently hot and humid

housing.description: Modern 1BR in value-strong Binh Thanh or the edge of District 2, pool

dining.description: Pho, banh mi, com tam from street stalls, occasional Western/Japanese

healthcare.description: Individual regional/international basic plan, FV Hospital access (thin local market)

entertainment.description: Bia hoi, rooftop bars, weekend trips, gym

1M.lifestyle: A modern one-bedroom in value-strong Binh Thanh or the edge of District 2, with a pool and basic amenities. Daily meals are pho, banh mi, and com tam from street stalls — cheap and excellent — with the occasional Western or Japanese night out. A motorbike or Grab bike gets around the sprawl, and a regional/international health plan covers FV Hospital. English is limited, so errands take some adaptation; the payoff is a dollar that stretches in a loud, high-energy city.

housing.description: Spacious 2-bedroom apartment in Thao Dien (District 2) or a modern serviced apartment in District 1

dining.description: Vietnamese street food mixed with the booming District 1 and District 2 restaurant scene — Vietnamese, Korean, French, and fusion

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private insurance with full access to FV Hospital, one of Vietnam's best

transportation.description: Own motorbike plus regular Grab car rides; occasional domestic flights to Da Nang or Phu Quoc

entertainment.description: Gym membership, cooking classes, weekend trips to beach towns, vibrant nightlife, live music scene

2M.lifestyle: A spacious apartment in leafy Thao Dien or a serviced unit near District 1, dining out regularly across the booming Vietnamese, Korean, French, and fusion scene. A motorbike plus routine Grab rides, a comprehensive international plan with FV access, and cheap flights to Da Nang or Phu Quoc for beach weekends. Value stays strong and life is comfortable. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Smart 1BR/2BR in a premium Thao Dien compound or a District 1 high-rise with skyline views

dining.description: Saigon's best regularly — French colonial, omakase, top Vietnamese

healthcare.description: Mid international plan with VIP FV access, regional coverage

transportation.description: Hired car and driver or heavy Grab, domestic flights

entertainment.description: Gym, golf, spa, weekend resort stays

3M.lifestyle: A smart one- or two-bedroom in a premium Thao Dien compound or a District 1 high-rise with skyline views. Regular dining at Saigon's best — French colonial rooms, Japanese omakase, top Vietnamese — with heavy Grab through the traffic and a hired car for occasions. A mid international plan with VIP hospital access and domestic flights wherever the mood goes. A genuinely affluent life at a fraction of Western cost.

housing.description: Grand villa in Thao Dien compound with private pool and garden, or top-floor penthouse in the Landmark 81 area

dining.description: Private chef specializing in Vietnamese and French cuisine; fine dining out several times weekly at top establishments

healthcare.description: Top-tier global insurance with Singapore and Bangkok evacuation; executive health checks; personalized wellness plans

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle with full-time driver; domestic first-class flights; regional business-class travel

entertainment.description: Elite golf memberships, private art gallery tours, luxury resort stays across Vietnam, regular regional travel

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper and cook, part-time gardener, nanny or personal assistant

luxuryExtras.description: Bespoke ao dai tailoring, Vietnamese art collection, premium spa memberships, wine collection, philanthropic work with local charities

5M.lifestyle: A large villa in a Thao Dien gated community with pool and garden, or a top-floor unit near Landmark 81, with a housekeeper and cook running the home. A luxury car with a full-time driver, business-class regional travel, and premium global health cover with Singapore/Bangkok evacuation. This budget stretches well past what the city demands. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large villa with pool in Thao Dien/An Phu

dining.description: Fine dining as routine plus a private chef sometimes

transportation.description: Car with full-time driver, domestic first-class flights

entertainment.description: Elite golf, art, luxury resort stays, regional travel

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper plus a cook and a part-time gardener for the residence

10M.lifestyle: A large villa with pool and garden in Thao Dien or An Phu, staffed by a housekeeper, an occasional cook, a driver, and a gardener. Concierge global health cover with regional screenings, fine dining as routine, and first-class international travel. This is far more than Saigon's market requires — you live at the very top of what the city offers, though its infrastructure, pollution, and limited English stay real daily factors at any budget.
